title: RegistryEntry
description: SAIA-Class S registry entry representing an immutable or versioned record within the Beast System 3.0 registry fabric.

entryId.description: Unique identifier for this registry entry (UUID recommended).

type.description: Type of registry entry (identity, credential, governance-event, policy, document, etc.).

version.description: Version label for this entry (semantic, date-based, or sovereign revision code).

status.description: Operational status of the registry entry.

payload.description: The full content of the record being stored in the registry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the registry entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the registry entry was last updated.

createdBy.description: Identity ID of the creator of this entry.

updatedBy.description: Identity ID of the last updater of this entry.

ledgerAnchor.description: Optional blockchain or DAO anchor reference (transaction hash, UUID, or external anchor).

signature.description: Cryptographic signature proving authenticity and integrity of the registry entry.
